comments.body: No need to rebase if it can be merged, no?
Seems like I need to work on that a little bit more.

> No need to rebase if it can be merged, no?

If it can be merged, it can be rebased :). Ideally it would be better to rebase every PR, but this requires to switch back to cli, force push and then accept the pr (there's an issue [about that already](https://github.com/isaacs/github/issues/88)).
if it's only a single commit that updates the version, it can be done again. Done it with NPM2 this time.
Yup seems good now, all the changes about resolved/.. are npm weirdness they try to fix since 2 years
